paragraphs: The All-in-One Open-Source Academic, Engineering, & Developer Utilities Suite 158 free, privacy-first, client-side tools with zero tracking, zero accounts, and zero server roundtrips.
StudentKit is a unified, lightning-fast digital workstation created for students, developers, researchers, and engineers.
Most online utility sites are riddled with popups, invasive trackers, paywalls, slow server roundtrips, and bloated layouts. StudentKit does the opposite:
features: 100% Client-Side: All calculations, conversions, string manipulations, and file analyses happen directly in your browser.
Privacy-First: No data leaves your machine. Your GPA marks, private code snippets, and calculations are never uploaded or tracked.
💾 Smart Draft Persistence: Real-time debounced auto-save to browser localStorage across tools with one-click reset—never lose your work when accidentally refreshing or closing tabs.

📄 One-Click Multi-Format Export: Copy structured summaries directly for Notion, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp, or export distraction-free, print-optimized academic PDFs for college advisors and homework submissions.
Instant Response: Built on Vite and React 19 for instantaneous computation with zero network latency.
